properties.name: Idlewild Park
properties.tip: Loop the rose garden and the duck ponds, then find a river bench.

properties.name: Virginia Lake Park
properties.tip: Walk the bench-lined east shore to the halfway point and back.

properties.name: Huffaker Park
properties.tip: The main paved loop at a stroll, with a view pause at the far end.

properties.name: Mira Loma Park
properties.tip: One easy lap of the main path — or half a lap and a bench.

properties.name: Wingfield Park / Downtown Riverwalk
properties.tip: Circle the island, cross one bridge, coffee optional.

properties.name: Oxbow Nature Study Area
properties.tip: The river-overlook stretch, pausing at each interpretive sign.

properties.name: Rancho San Rafael Regional Park
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: Front lawns to the pond and back — flat the whole way.

properties.name: Wilbur D. May Arboretum
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: Wander to Herman Pond and back, reading plant labels as you go.

properties.name: Mayberry Park
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: Upstream along the river to the footbridge and back.

properties.name: Dorostkar Park
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: The river nature loop under the cottonwoods.

properties.name: Galena Creek Regional Park
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: The visitor-center nature loop among the Jeffrey pines.

properties.name: Swan Lake Nature Study Area
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: Boardwalk out to the viewing area, sit, count species, walk back.

properties.name: Thomas Creek Park
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: Creekside out-and-back at whatever distance feels right.

properties.name: Bartley Ranch Regional Park
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: The ranch-core loop past the historic buildings.

properties.name: Caughlin Ranch paths
properties.tip: Pond-to-pond along the main path and back.

properties.name: Steamboat Ditch Trail
properties.tip: Any stretch you like: it's flat in both directions, so walk out ten minutes and turn around.

properties.name: Damonte Ranch Wetlands / Damonte Ranch Trail
properties.tip: Walk to the second viewing bench and back; early morning and dusk are busiest for birds.

properties.name: Sparks Marina Park
properties.tip: Out-and-back along the west shore — ten minutes out, ten back, benches the whole way.

properties.name: McCarran Ranch Preserve
properties.parking: Limited — Small dirt lot; no restrooms or developed facilities
properties.tip: The river-access path just past the trailhead sign, before the trail turns rockier.

properties.name: Verdi Nature Trail at Crystal Peak Park
properties.manager: Nevada Department of Wildlife & Washoe County
properties.tip: The interpretive loop, unhurried — or skip it entirely and sit by Verdi Pond.

properties.name: Bowers Mansion Regional Park
properties.manager: Washoe County Regional Parks & Open Space
properties.tip: Circle the mansion grounds, then claim a lawn bench under the big trees.

properties.name: Washoe Lake State Park
properties.tip: Shoreline stroll from the main day-use lawn, watching Slide Mountain change color.

properties.name: Spooner Lake State Park
properties.tip: The first stretch of the lake loop through the aspens, then back the same way.

properties.name: Sand Harbor / Lake Tahoe Nevada State Park
properties.tip: The point boardwalk, slowly. That water color is the therapy.

properties.name: Tahoe East Shore Trail access areas
properties.tip: From the Incline trailhead, walk to the first overlook and back.

properties.name: Mormon Station State Historic Park
properties.tip: The grounds loop plus the stockade, then a bench under the cottonwoods.

properties.name: Dayton State Park
properties.tip: The shaded picnic-area paths — save the mill trail for a stronger day.

properties.name: Fort Churchill State Historic Park
properties.tip: The ruins loop with the interpretive signs. October through April is your window.
